content.short: TRM Labs provides blockchain intelligence for compliance, sanctions screening and risk management.
content.description: TRM Labs builds the transaction monitoring and sanctions screening tooling that regulated institutions and public sector agencies use to trace illicit activity on-chain. Monad's documentation lists it under analytics, and Robinhood Chain names it among its launch infrastructure partners for compliance. A chain carrying tokenized equities needs this layer present from day one rather than added later.
